title: Bladder metastasis from cutaneous melanoma during adjuvant immunotherapy: A case report and literature review

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】The patient then initiated first-line treatment with nivolumab and ipilimumab, achieving an ongoing clinical and radiological partial response.

The patient then initiated first-line treatment with nivolumab and ipilimumab, achieving an ongoing clinical and radiological partial response.
